release_notes: Build 118 adds a canonical SQLite publication_state model for YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, the Factburst website, and promotional Shorts.
Full quizzes and promo Shorts now use separate publication records, preventing a promo upload from overwriting or being confused with its parent quiz upload state.
Publication State in Upload Manager reconciles existing quiz history, detailed upload journal records, remote IDs, schedules, errors, and existing promo metadata without deleting the legacy records.
Website preparation now records durable in-progress, scheduled, published, and failed states locally, including the last website error when a sync needs attention.
Build 117 permanent project folders and all earlier publishing safeguards remain included unchanged.
